name: Multimedia Design

credential.title: AP degree – academy profession, not a bachelor's

summary: A two-year AP in UX, interface design and front-end programming, with company projects and a ten-week internship. AP entrants in 2027 cannot continue to the existing 18-month bachelor top-ups. Digital Concept Development has its final intake in August 2027.
description: Design websites, apps and digital services using UX/UI, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, React and AI tools. The AP awards 120 ECTS; the international line adds 10 extra programming ECTS.

structure.teachingStyle: Small-group classes, company cases, workshops, project work and individual assignments.
structure.assessment: Students build a portfolio through the programme and finish with a final exam project.
structure.placement: Compulsory ten-week internship in semester four; students find their placement with academy support.
structure.studyAbroad: Exchange, summer school or internship abroad are possible.
